demo.title: hoodgrow-x402.sh
demo.code:
# HoodGrow: Robinhood Chain stock token data. Pay-per-call over x402 (USDC on Base, no signup),
# get a free self-serve API key at https://www.hoodgrow.com/builders (40 req/day, no payment),
# or prepay a credit balance once and spend it with a gas-free wallet signature.
# 1) Call an endpoint - no key means HTTP 402 with payment terms in the `payment-required` header
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/tokens"          # full catalog - $0.10
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/token/NVDA"      # one symbol - $0.05
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/corporate-actions"     # corporate actions only - $0.05

# 2) Pay the advertised USDC amount on Base with your x402-capable agent/wallet,
#    then retry the same URL with the payment proof to receive JSON:
#    price, corporate-action adjusted supply, Morpho/Uniswap DeFi depth, and
#    pending/historical corporate actions. Or add `-H "Authorization: Bearer <key>"`
#    with a free or paid key, or the X-HoodGrow-Credit-* headers with a prepaid
#    balance (see POST /api/agent/credits/purchase), instead of paying per call.

# Human-readable docs: https://www.hoodgrow.com/api-access

setup: No signup required. An x402-capable agent/wallet funded with USDC on Base, a free self-serve API key from https://www.hoodgrow.com/builders (40 requests/day, no payment), or a prepaid credit balance (see below).

Call `GET https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/tokens` (full catalog, $0.10), `GET https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/token/{symbol}` (one token, $0.05), or `GET https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/corporate-actions` (corporate actions only, $0.05). More market-data endpoints, all $0.05: `/api/agent/defi/{symbol}`, `/api/agent/holders/{symbol}`, `/api/agent/slippage/{symbol}`, `/api/agent/ohlc/{symbol}` (OHLC + swap volume), `/api/agent/markets` (movers), `/api/agent/trades` (recent large trades) — see SKILL.md.
With a key: send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Without one: on HTTP 402, pay the advertised USDC amount on Base and retry to receive structured JSON.

Prepaid credits: `POST https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/credits/purchase?bundle=<id>` (x402-payable, GET the same URL for the bundle catalog) once, then send `X-HoodGrow-Credit-Wallet` / `-Timestamp` / `-Signature` headers on any call above to spend from the balance instead of paying x402 per call — see SKILL.md's "Prepaid credits" section for the exact signed-message format.

Or skip raw HTTP: `npm i hoodgrow` / `pip install hoodgrow` for a typed client that handles x402 payment (or a bearer key) for you, or `npx hoodgrow-mcp` for an MCP server if your agent is an MCP client.
